say: What are your students really saying?
Every semester, hundreds of comments pile up. And most of them? Never read.
It sorts every comment by what it's about. Subject knowledge. Clarity. Punctuality. Pace.
Names and phone numbers vanish before anyone sees them. Abuse is held back.
For students, it's one simple form per teacher. Rate eight things that matter, add a few words, and send. No names, ever.
Teachers get one honest page. Their score, the wall of comments by aspect, and the real words behind every point.
Clear strengths, things to work on, and a next step for each. Plus a profile that writes itself, published only when they approve it.
Heads of department see their whole department. Every teacher, every aspect, a fair bias check, and what was done about the feedback.
And the I Q A C office exports the N A A C report, in one click.
FacultyLens. Every comment, sorted and heard.
